conclusions: Source positions and columns for ordinary JavaScript are indices in the actual V8 string: Latin-1/one-byte entries or UTF-16 code units. A supplementary character occupies two positions; display UTF-8 byte counts do not establish these positions.
Line-end calculation recognizes LF, lone CR, U+2028 and U+2029. CR immediately before LF is not recorded separately: the LF is the line-end entry.

include_ending_line=true appends source.length, including for empty source and after a trailing terminator. Thus initialized cached lookup accepts EOF and yields an empty trailing line after a final terminator.
Initialized cached lookup clamps negative position to zero and rejects only positions greater than the final sentinel. It finds the first line-end >= position, with subsequent line_start=prior_end+1.
Native Script line and column are zero-based. Origin column_offset is added only on the original first line; origin line_offset is then added on every line.

Source PositionInfo.line_end is the linebreak index (or final sentinel), then decremented when the immediately preceding code unit is CR. This affects returned line content, not the already calculated column.

The non-static path without initialized line_ends deliberately uses a separate LF-only scan; empty strings fail there, and it does not share cached CR/Unicode-terminator behavior. Static GetPositionInfo initializes line ends first. The consumer must select the actual original route.

Native origin projection uses GetNameOrSourceURL, exact line/column offsets, ID, source_mapping_url, host_defined_options and actual shared/opaque/module bits. Source URL takes precedence whenever it is not undefined.
Actual Script types are native0, extension1, normal2, optional wasm3, inspector4; CompilationType is host0/eval1. These are separate from ScriptOrigin option bits shared1/opaque2/wasm4/module8.

Public ScriptOrigin defaults offsets0, ID-1, option bitsfalse and absent optional handles. Factory NewScript uses the real next Script ID and initially normal type, zero offsets/flags, name undefined, line_ends Smi0 (not computed), and empty native host-defined-options array.
Message::GetEndColumn is start_column+(end_position-start_position), preserving the actual span; it does not re-derive the end from a displayed line/column.
limits: No compiler or VM source edits or execution.
No choice of new QuickJS metadata representation is qualified here.
Message creation/catch/report policy remains outside this position/origin proof.
New String/char predicate originals are preserved as immutable source excerpts with explicit full raw and stored-extraction hashes; no full-file read is claimed for those excerpts.
